name: Vadinar refinery delayed coking unit (Essar Oil, now Nayara Energy), Gujarat, India
description: delayed coker described as one of the largest in the world (unit capacity not published in the open article); part of the expansion that lifted the refinery from 200,000 to 405,000 bpd (20 Mt/yr) with Nelson complexity 6.1 to 11.8; commissioned by CB&I in 2012 after a 30-month EPC
